events.verdict: Nembhard (DAL) is bracing for the contact from Murray (DEN) and he releases away from the contact at the end of the drive.
Watson (DEN) briefly grasps Gafford's (DAL) jersey as he deflects the ball away with his right hand.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Watson (DEN) and Davis (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) and Gafford (DAL) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) directly contests Marshall's (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Marshall's hand after the release.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Marshall's (DAL) path prior to the contact.
Marshall (DAL) loses his footing on his own and not as a result of any contact from Jokic (DEN).
Brown (DEN) is moving alongside Flagg's (DAL) path as he defends the drive.
Brown (DEN) legally contests Flagg's (DAL) shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) initiates contact with Davis' (DAL) arm that affects his ability to secure the rebound.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Hardaway Jr.'s (DEN) jump shot and would avoid making contact entirely if not for the foot extension from Hardaway Jr. to create the contact.
Davis (DAL) brings his hands towards Watson (DEN) as he releases away from the contact.
Jokic (DEN) moves alongside Flagg's (DAL) path as he defends the drive.
Watson (DEN) directly contests Nembhard's (DAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Nembhard's hand after the release.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Martin's (DAL) path prior to the contact.

Jokic (DEN) gathers the pass with a jump stop, after which he may establish either foot as his pivot.  He moves his left foot, establishing his right as his pivot foot, and he does not maintain his pivot foot before releasing the pass.
Martin (DAL) and Jokic (DEN) come together at the same spot, and the contact is marginal.
